receipt.public_excerpt: Current language models sometimes produce false outputs

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI documents continuing factuality problems and evaluates GPT-4o and o1-preview, among other models, on short factual questions without browsing. The dataset deliberately targets difficult questions, so its results establish remaining weaknesses rather than everyday error prevalence.

Controlled variations of mathematical problems expose recurring fragility in the tested models' reasoning performance. This supports an unresolved weakness without adopting the authors' stronger hypothesis that models cannot perform genuine logical reasoning.

The benchmark operator reports substantial progress in adaptation to unfamiliar tasks for the o3 preview. This qualifies any suggestion of stagnation, but does not establish reliable solutions across the three named domains; the same report describes remaining failures.

unresolved_gaps: These evaluations do not cover every model, task, prompting method, or tool-assisted system available at year-end.
The research reports do not consistently give exact test-execution dates. Month-level event dates identify the contemporary capability findings documented in the original reports.
The attribution to Marcus's 2001 and 2022 writings is not independently assessed.
